display.explanation: Waitangi Day invites reflection on the covenant of Te Tiriti o Waitangi and prayer for justice, mutual respect and a shared future in Aotearoa.
display.prompt: Pray for faithfulness to our promises, respect for one another’s taonga, and justice in our life together.

sentences.label: Sentence — Māori
sentences.text: Anō te pai, anō te ahuareka o te nohoanga o ngā tēina o ngā tuākana i runga i te whakaaro kotahi.

sentences.label: Sentence — English
sentences.text: How good and pleasant a thing it is when God’s people live together in unity.

sentences.label: Post-communion sentence — Māori
sentences.text: Ka whakatikatika e ia i ō tātou waewae ki te huarahi o te rangimārie.

sentences.label: Post-communion sentence — English
sentences.text: God will guide our feet into the way of peace.

collects.text:
E te Ariki o ngā ariki,
i mea koe
ki te ū koutou ki roto ki ahau
ka ū anō āku kupu ki roto ki a koutou.
E pupuri tonu nei mātou
i ngā kupu o te kawenata o te Tiriti o Waitangi
i hainatia e ngā Māori me ngā Pākehā
i te tau kotahi mano e waru rau e whā tekau.
Meinga ēnei kupu i poua nei e rātou
hei māramatanga mō ngā rā kei mua i a mātou
e haere tika ai tēnei iwi o Aotearoa. Āmine.

Collect 2 — English

collects.text:
God of covenant and calling,
you bind us together;
keep us faithful to our calling
and true to our promises.
